notes: Rolling four-week firm commitment on the group's highest-volume SKU. Full non-delivery exposure is EUR 1,054,000 in direct penalty before any service-level rebate. Produced at both PLANT-FR-01 and PLANT-BE-01, so it is the only affected commitment with dual-plant coverage.

PLANT-FR-01 depletes pectin on 2026-09-15, eight working days before this delivery. Flagged at risk on 2026-09-03. Highest-margin yogurt in the portfolio at 38.2%, so both revenue and margin exposure are material.

Kids organic pouch produced only on FR01-L3. Organic certification blocks the amidated LM pectin route, so this commitment can only be protected by alternate sourcing or reallocation, not by reformulation.
E.Leclerc accepted a plain-yogurt substitution during the 2024 shortage and the account team believes a partial swap to SKU-YOG-011 is negotiable again if raised before 2026-09-10.
Delivery falls well beyond the PLANT-FR-01 depletion date and depends entirely on securing alternate supply from SUP-EU-023 within the 21-day lead time.
No penalty clause and forecast rather than firm status, which makes this the cheapest volume to cut. Offset by a 2027 range-expansion negotiation the commercial team is protecting.

Harshest branded penalty clause in the portfolio. Full non-delivery exposure is EUR 756,000 in direct penalty plus a 4% quarterly rebate if fill rate drops below 97%. PLANT-DE-02 depletes on 2026-09-18.
Not organic certified, so this is one of the few at-risk commitments where an LM pectin reformulation is technically permitted, subject to the 31 to 45 day re-validation critical path.
Regional buying structure across seven desks means allocation notification takes roughly 24 hours longer than for a centralised account. Must be started early in the 48-hour notification window.
No penalty clause, but price-led buying behaviour and low switching cost mean a sustained out-of-stock carries genuine competitor-substitution risk rather than a financial penalty.
Highest-margin SKU in the portfolio at 41.3%. Carries an on-pack vegetarian claim, so gelatin substitution is not available. PLANT-BE-01 depletes on 2026-09-21, the latest of the three sites.
Deliverable within the 18-day Ghent runway if the BE01-L1 campaign is protected, which is the main argument for decampaigning SKU-YOG-010 and SKU-DES-004 instead.

Highest per-unit penalty in the book at EUR 1.20 and a 98% SLA into schools and hospitals. The 30-day specification-change notice period in this contract rules out any emergency reformulation on Sodexo volume.

Private-label contract with a termination right if fill rate falls below 95% in two consecutive quarters. Lowest-margin affected SKU at 26.4% but the highest contractual consequence, which is exactly the case the allocation policy warns about.

Conflict case: SKU-YOG-010 is the primary decampaigning candidate at Ghent on margin-per-kilogram grounds, but it sits under the harshest penalty clause in the book. Requires Commercial Director adjudication before the production plan is frozen.
